inherits: upl_development_r1.json; retain original equations, failed attempts and bounded-stage receipts as historical evidence
user_priority: Complete u-pl compatibility with the actual benchmark loads, drainage and boundaries; retain default u-pw OFF behavior.
First constant-k case02 short window covering loading and drainage, then independent half and justified full consolidation. Compare dynamic porosity/seepage separately from evolving conductivity.

After the 1D short gates, prepare Cryer 3D while the admitted consolidation long run is executing: nu=.3 peak window first, then full decay and other nu values. Lian follows justified compatibility work; Yao remains deferred.
If benchmark accuracy is comparable to the accepted u-pw baseline, validate retrogressive landslide before Selborne. Improvement in every benchmark metric is not mandatory.

TPI or another integrator is conditional on measured equal-accuracy cost; nonlocal or other regularization is conditional on particle-spacing sensitivity. Strong unresolved slip-band sensitivity must be addressed before quantitative Selborne claims.
Perform small regression-protected interface consolidation and efficiency work after a path is stable. Do not combine broad refactoring with an unverified physical change.

current_evidence.scope: Private GPU weak elastic opposing FreeSlip planes, tangential gravity, constant k: native safety, saved-endpoint audits, five comparisons and direct constant reference independently reviewed.
current_evidence.not_admitted: Variable-k gravity wall, normal gravity, actual consolidation, Cryer, public gravity or a general u-pl release.
current_evidence.next_priority: Actual constant-k benchmark load/drain/bottom-boundary compatibility. Planned variable-k tangential-gravity wall jobs have not been launched and are not prerequisites to starting this integration.
current_evidence.history: Original periodic combined signal checks remain failed; reviewed conditional A plus separate manufactured B evidence must not be relabeled as passing those original combined checks.

minimum_components: Same-stage drained pressure and pressure-rate constraints; preserve volumetric rate and J integration on drained particles.
TopKernelBand resultant under the current J-derived volume and mixture inertia; retain the original reference force target and avoid double loading/gravity.
Single bottom impermeable fixed-plane closure plus horizontal periodicity; clearly label any FreeSlip/HG/SPR/viscosity/damping differences from the accepted formal case.
case02_admission.short_window: Must cross the actual loading/drainage event, not merely complete a two-step startup smoke.
case02_admission.comparisons: Fresh matched-setting u-pw OFF and dynamic ON; independent same-model half checks, native IDs and actual clocks. Option changes are not half-step errors. Record theory, settling, stress, load, stability and cost separately.
case02_admission.protection: Keep existing formal XML/BAT, outputs, figures, executable packages and all retained evidence unchanged. Do not merely remove unsupported-state guards.

server_delivery.target: Windows x64 and NVIDIA RTX A6000; actual server hardware/runtime must be recorded, not inferred from local RTX3050 runs.
server_delivery.trigger: Retrogressive-landslide long runs, multiple conditions or sensitivity studies after necessary local admission.
payload: Case-root-style XML and independently named double-click BAT entry points using relative paths.
Verified frozen Release executable, required DLL/config/GenCase files and input/program/runtime hash manifest.
One shallow output location per condition, a condition matrix and run instructions. Refuse existing outputs and preserve partial runs.
Local smoke instructions and separate full-run entry points; a smoke pass does not automatically launch or accept a long run.
Observed execution receipt: actual executable/input/generated-XML hashes, GPU/driver, command, start/end, exit and sealed final time.
Return-data checklist and matching offline analysis/figures/CSV support; do not claim server plotting unless actually included.
server_delivery.parallel_policy: CPU concurrency and GPU job concurrency are admitted only after measuring memory and throughput; use a controlled queue by default on a single GPU. No duplicate solver or remote launch is implied by this plan.
server_delivery.restart: Do not promise exact HG or cross-model PART restart without separate implementation and validation.
server_delivery.backup: Selectively verify local and remote Git for source/config/support/evidence; ignored raw BI4 and executables require a separate preserved payload, not a claim of cloud Git backup.

communication: Continue within the authorized scope without routine approval pauses. Report stage transitions, measured outcomes and important failures proactively; during long execution use one verified completion mechanism. Pause only for a material physical-plan disagreement, missing authority or an external blocker.
